question: What healing and all-encompassing qualities are attributed to the divine in salutation?
premises: The divine is addressed as medicine of qualities.
The divine is addressed as the abode of all.
inference: The divine is honored as both remedial power and universal dwelling place.
uncertainties: guṇa-auṣadhāya may mean medicine possessing qualities or medicine for qualities.
plain_english: Obeisance to the medicine of qualities, obeisance to the abode of all.
